content.text: The Mistake Almost Every Creator Makes First

The mistake almost every creator makes first is trying to integrate popular payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe into their online store. While these platforms are widely accepted internationally, they are notoriously restrictive when it comes to integration in certain countries like Tanzania. As a result, creators who try to use these platforms often find themselves stuck with limited payment options or, worse still, having their accounts suspended for allegedly violating platform policies. This can be devastating for creators who have invested time and resources into [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-step-step-deployment-6|COREMERCH guide to building]] their online presence.
Why This Keeps Happening Even to Experienced Sellers

This happens even to experienced sellers because they are often unaware of the infrastructure risks associated with using popular payment platforms. They may have heard about the benefits of these platforms, such as ease of use and global acceptance, but they may not realize that these benefits come with significant limitations and restrictions. Moreover, these platforms often have complex and opaque policies that can catch creators off guard, leading to account suspensions and lost revenue.
The Real Cost of Getting This Wrong

The real cost of getting this wrong is significant. Not only can creators lose potential customers and revenue streams, but they may also have to invest time and resources into rebuilding their online presence from scratch. This can be especially true for creators who have built their business around a particular payment platform, only to find themselves locked out when the platform restricts their access. In the end, the real cost of getting this wrong may be the very existence of the business.
Creating a sovereign digital commerce stack is the only way to ensure that your online store is free from platform restrictions and limitations.
How to Build the Stack That Cannot Be Taken Down

The good news is that creators do not have to rely on popular payment platforms to sell their digital products online. By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can ensure that their online store is free from platform restrictions and limitations. This means using infrastructure like Cloudflare Pages, NOWPayments, and Supabase to create a payment system that is custom-built for the needs of the business. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can control their own destiny and avoid the risks associated with relying on popular payment platforms.
The Infrastructure Decision That Changes Everything

The infrastructure decision that changes everything is the choice to use a blockchain-based payment solution like NOWPayments. This solution allows creators to accept payments from customers all over the world, without having to rely on traditional payment platforms that are often restrictive and expensive. With NOWPayments, creators can settle payments in seconds, for a fee of under $0.10, using cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron. This means that creators can get paid faster and cheaper, while also avoiding the risks associated with relying on traditional payment platforms.
